manifest_summary.approach: Paper-only long-only multi-horizon momentum with 22-close warmup. Enter only when 7-bar log return exceeds 0.003+0.25*sigma20*sqrt(6), 21-bar log return is positive and latest close exceeds its 20-close mean. Buy quantity is 500/(decision_close*1.0005*1.001), rounded to ten decimals; otherwise retain cash. Fixed sizing buffer is heuristic, not a guarantee against unknown next-close gaps. Fee 10bp, slippage 5bp, no leverage.
